No files yet. Add bills, warranties, insurance policies or photos of what you own, then link each to the transactions, categories, goals and accounts it belongs to.

Files stay on your own server with the budget, never sent anywhere. Removing a link keeps the file; deleting a file removes its links. JSON backups carry files' details, not the files: use Download all to keep a copy of the files themselves.
